faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Marathwada Administrative and Development Training Institute Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Marathwada Administrative and Development Training Institute Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 1 Registrar and Assistant Professor (Class-1), 6 Assistant Professor (Class-1), 1 Office Superintendent / Stenographer (Class-3), 1 Hostel and Campus Manager (Class-3), 1 Librarian (Class-3).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Marathwada Administrative and Development Training Institute Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure D, page 2 of this notice) and send it to Director, Marathwada Administrative and Development Training Institute, Nathnagar (North), Paithan, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, by through the officer's administrative department, to reach by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: S-19: 55100-175100 for Registrar and Assistant Professor (Class-1), S-19: 55100-175100 for Assistant Professor (Class-1), S-13: 35400-112400 for Office Superintendent / Stenographer (Class-3), S-13: 35400-112400 for Hostel and Campus Manager (Class-3), S-8: 25500-81100 for Librarian (Class-3).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Serving government officers/employees holding the qualification and experience prescribed for equivalent posts in the parent cadre, applying for deputation. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be currently serving in government service. Applications received after 15-11-2026 will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers whose applications do not arrive by the due date are not considered.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received through proper channel are considered and forwarded to the General Administration Department, Mantralaya, Mumbai for further action. Initial period of 3 years deputation. Scrutiny of applications by General Administration Department.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation is first for three years. Period may be extended up to 5 years with the consent of the controlling authority.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Nathnagar (North), Paithan, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.
